name: Circo dos Horrores
source:
The Circus of Horrors has arrived in town.

Uncover its secrets and face the terror it hides, all while being led by Pierrot, the silent yandere, or Harlequin, his seductive rival. Don’t be fooled by their smiles, they’re not what they seem.

You work at a café, and one day, on your way to work, fate leads you to cross paths with Pierrot. That’s when his obsession begins. But he’s not alone,  his stage rival decides to join the game, turning this twisted dance into a dangerous competition… all for you.

[From [url=https://garula.itch.io/the-freak-circus]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
恐怖马戏团已抵达镇上。

揭开它的秘密，面对它隐藏的恐惧，同时由沉默的病态者皮埃罗或他诱人的对手丑角领导。不要被他们的笑容所迷惑，他们并不像看上去的那样。

你在一家咖啡馆工作，有一天，在你上班的路上，命运让你遇见了皮埃罗。那是他的痴迷开始的时候。但他并不孤单，他的舞台对手决定加入游戏，将这种扭曲的舞蹈变成一场危险的比赛……一切都是为了你。

[来自[url=https://garula.itch.io/the-freak-circus]Itch.io[/url]]
